changes.justification: The candidate is an explicitly versioned capability golden, not a replacement parity golden.
The source is the opt-in integrated-v1 implementation committed after parity migration.
Power parameters are required to distinguish actuator overhead from productive propulsion energy.
Commands strictly inside the dead zone intentionally produce zero thrust; exact thresholds remain active.
Threshold-adjacent samples document the deliberate strict-inequality boundary rule.
Failed-off now removes the actuator wrench after the reviewed transition point.
Capability status text now records functional dead-zone, failure, and opt-in version semantics.
New evidence records energy attribution, failure events, stuck-bias diagnostics, and checkpoint replay identity.
